name: sRGB
description: Standard Red Green Blue — the default color space for the web, images, and most displays. Gamma-encoded (non-linear). Defined with respect to a D65 white point.

gamma.forward: C_srgb = C_linear * 12.92 if C_linear <= 0.0031308, else 1.055 * C_linear^(1/2.4) - 0.055

use_cases: Input to any color conversion pipeline
do_not_use_for: Color distance calculations — use CIELAB ΔE
art_notes: sRGB is the lingua franca of digital color — everything eventually lands here for display. But it's a terrible space for arithmetic. The gamma curve is designed for display hardware, not math. Always linearize before doing any computation.
